origin.description: Wrap paragraphs to a given width using ICU line breaks.
origin.usage: stri_wrap(str, width = floor(0.9 * getOption("width")), cost_exponent = 2, simplify = TRUE, normalize = TRUE, normalise = normalize, indent = 0, exdent = 0, prefix = "", initial = prefix, whitespace_only = FALSE, use_length = FALSE, locale = NULL)

arguments.name: width
arguments.text: The target width. A non-positive value becomes 0.

arguments.name: cost_exponent
arguments.text: Zero or less selects a greedy fit. A positive value selects Knuth's dynamic program.

arguments.name: normalize
arguments.text: If TRUE, join lines, merge spaces, trim, and apply NFC before wrapping.

arguments.name: indent
arguments.text: Extra width on the first line.

arguments.name: exdent
arguments.text: Extra width on the later lines.

arguments.name: use_length
arguments.text: If TRUE, measure code points instead of display width.

arguments.name: locale
arguments.text: The locale for the line-break iterator. NULL uses the default.

origin.details: Breaks come from ICU unless whitespace_only is TRUE. The last line of the dynamic program costs nothing. A negative indent or exdent is an error.
origin.value: A character vector when simplify is TRUE, otherwise a list of lines.
origin.example: s <- "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipisicing elit. Proin nibh augue, suscipit a, scelerisque sed, lacinia in, mi. Cras vel lorem. Etiam pellentesque aliquet tellus."; cat(paste0("stri_wrap(s, 20, 0) returns ", length(stri_wrap(s, 20, 0)), " lines.\n"))

translation.description: Wrap paragraphs to a given width using ICU line breaks.
translation.usage: stri_wrap(str, width=72, cost_exponent=2, simplify=True, normalize=True, normalise=None, indent=0, exdent=0, prefix='', initial=None, whitespace_only=False, use_length=False, locale=None)

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A string, NA, or a list of those.

arguments.name: width
arguments.text: The target width. A non-positive value becomes 0.

arguments.name: cost_exponent
arguments.text: Zero or less selects a greedy fit. A positive value selects Knuth's dynamic program.

arguments.name: normalize
arguments.text: If True, join lines, merge spaces, trim, and apply NFC before wrapping.

arguments.name: indent
arguments.text: Extra width on the first line.

arguments.name: exdent
arguments.text: Extra width on the later lines.

arguments.name: use_length
arguments.text: If True, measure code points instead of stri_width.

arguments.name: locale
arguments.text: The locale for the line-break iterator. None uses the default.

translation.details: Breaks come from icu.BreakIterator.createLineInstance. Offsets are UTF-16 code units. A missing string stays NA when simplify is True. A negative indent or exdent raises ValueError.
translation.value: A list of lines when simplify is True. A missing input string stays NA.
translation.example:
s = "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipisicing elit. Proin nibh augue, suscipit a, scelerisque sed, lacinia in, mi. Cras vel lorem. Etiam pellentesque aliquet tellus."
print(f"stri_wrap(s, 20, 0) returns {len(stri_wrap(s, 20, 0))} lines.")
